comparison.interpretation: RAG covers one additional Gold rule but produces two outside-Gold outputs and one duplicate; LLM-only has slightly higher primary F1.

methodological_limitations: RAG is a hybrid assembly of separate generation runs, not a controlled single generation.
Canonical MAIN is tx01_rag_main(1).json; earlier malformed MAIN and combined_raw are not canonical.
Cause of malformed earlier MAIN is unknown; do not attribute to network.
RAG had six copybooks while LLM-only did not; conditions were not fully equal.
Gold Standard was assistant-assisted and user-reviewed, not independently blinded.
Semantic FULL/PARTIAL/NONE were human-approved in conversation, not independently adjudicated.
Older provisional hybrid experiment metrics and draft labels are superseded by this record, not silently overwritten.
Outside-Gold NONE may represent valid extraction rather than hallucination; frozen Gold remains unchanged.
RAG-15 FULL reflects correct rollback subbehavior but not all Gold trigger details; decision follows agreed lenient policy.
